# besttraveler

> besttraveler (https://besttraveler.ge) is a Georgian travel company that runs group tours from Georgia (Tbilisi, Kutaisi and Yerevan airports, or by minibus from Tbilisi) to 26 countries, and one-day tours around Georgia. Tour organiser: Natali Iashvili. Contact: phone/WhatsApp +995 579 57 56 36, email info@besttraveler.ge. The site is in Georgian (default), English (/en/) and Russian (/ru/).

Booking: a deposit holds a place; the rest is paid 15 days before the tour; money is not returned if the traveller cancels for their own reasons. Payment by bank transfer. Prices of flight tours depend on air fares and can change.

## Main pages

- [All tours — prices, dates and programmes](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/): Every besttraveler tour on one page: flight tours abroad, bus tours to Turkey and Armenia, and one-day tours around Georgia.
- [Destinations — countries we travel to](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/): Countries where besttraveler runs tours: Egypt, Italy, Spain, France, Turkey, Armenia, Greece and more, with prices and dates.
- [Booking and payment terms](https://besttraveler.ge/en/booking-terms/): How to book a besttraveler tour: deposit, paying the rest, refunds, passport rules and the documents children need to travel abroad.
- [Frequently asked questions about our tours](https://besttraveler.ge/en/faq/): Answers to common questions: how to book a tour, what the price includes, where tours start, which documents you need and when to pay.
- [About besttraveler — who we are](https://besttraveler.ge/en/about/): besttraveler organises group tours abroad and one-day tours in Georgia. Learn how we work, what our tours include and how to reach us.
- [Contact us — book a tour](https://besttraveler.ge/en/contact/): Contact besttraveler to book a tour: phone and WhatsApp +995 579 57 56 36, email info@besttraveler.ge, or Facebook. We reply quickly.

## Destinations

- [Tours to Egypt](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/egypt/): Group tours to Egypt from Tbilisi: Cairo and the Giza pyramids, Luxor, Aswan, Nile cruises and the Red Sea.
- [Tours to Italy](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/italy/): Group tours to Italy: Rome, Venice, Tuscany, Sicily, the Amalfi Coast and southern Italy.
- [Tours to Turkey](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/turkey/): Tours to Turkey: Istanbul, Cappadocia, historic Tao-Klarjeti, Trabzon, Kars, Van and Mardin.
- [Tours to Spain](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/spain/): Group tours to Spain: Barcelona, Andalusia, the Madrid region, and trips that add Portugal or Andorra.
- [Tours to France](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/france/): Group tours to France: Paris, Alsace, Provence, the Côte d'Azur and the Alps.
- [Tours to Greece](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/greece/): Group tours to Greece: Athens and the Acropolis, Aegina island, Thessaloniki and Meteora.
- [Tours to Armenia](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/armenia/): One-day and three-day tours to Armenia from Tbilisi by minibus: Dilijan, Lori, Lake Sevan, Yerevan and Tatev.
- [Tours to the Netherlands](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/netherlands/): Group tours to the Netherlands and Belgium: Amsterdam, Giethoorn, windmills, Keukenhof, Bruges and Ghent.
- [Tours to Sri Lanka](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/sri-lanka/): Group tours to Sri Lanka: Sigiriya, Kandy, tea plantations, the train to Ella, a safari and the ocean — with an optional Maldives extension.
- [Day tours in Georgia](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/georgia/): One-day tours from Tbilisi by minibus: Kakheti, Kazbegi, Truso, David Gareja, Javakheti, Lagodekhi and more.

## Articles

- [Entering Georgia in 2026: visa-free stay, insurance, passport](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/georgia-entry-rules-visa-insurance-2026/): Since 1 January 2026 every foreign tourist entering Georgia must hold health and accident insurance of at least 30,000 GEL that covers the whole stay. Citizens of 96 countries, including the EU, the USA, the UK, Russia, Belarus and Kazakhstan, need no visa and may stay up to one full year. This is the situation as of October 2026.
- [Svaneti Guide: What to See in Mestia and Ushguli and How to Get There](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/svaneti-mestia-ushguli-guide/): The highlights of Upper Svaneti are Mestia, with its Svan towers and the Svaneti Museum of History and Ethnography, and Ushguli, part of a UNESCO World Heritage Site. You reach Mestia by road via Zugdidi, or by a small plane from Natakhtari near Tbilisi. Plan at least 3 days.
- [Georgia in Winter: Weather, Skiing, Kazbegi and What to See](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/georgia-in-winter/): Winter in Georgia is mild in the lowlands: Tbilisi's average January high is about 6-7 °C, and Batumi's January average is about 5 °C. The mountains get plenty of snow, and ski resorts such as Gudauri, Bakuriani, Mestia and Goderdzi usually run from late December to April. Cities, museums and wine regions stay open all winter.
- [Georgia with Kids: Where to Go and Practical Tips for Families](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/georgia-with-kids/): Children usually love Sataplia with its dinosaur footprints, Prometheus Cave, the Batumi Botanical Garden and the sea, Borjomi park and Bakuriani. Choose tours with short walks, pack water, snacks and a warm layer, and remember that mountain day tours take the whole day.
- [Best Time to Visit Georgia: Seasons and Months Explained](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/best-time-to-visit-georgia/): For sightseeing and cities, the best times are late spring (May-June) and autumn (September-October). For the sea and the high mountains, choose July and August. The grape harvest (Rtveli) starts in Kakheti in September, and skiing usually runs from late December to April.
- [Truso Valley Day Trip from Tbilisi: Travertines, Ketrisi, Zakagori](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/truso-valley-day-trip/): Our Truso tour leaves Tbilisi at 07:00 and is back at about 22:00. In the valley you walk 6-7 km one way on an easy path. On the way you see colourful travertines, the 'bottomless' lake, Ketrisi village, Abano Convent and Zakagori Fortress.
- [David Gareja and the Colourful Mountains: What to See and Bring](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/david-gareja-colorful-mountains/): David Gareja is a rock-cut monastery complex founded in the 6th century, about 60-70 km southeast of Tbilisi in semi-desert. Our colourful desert tour combines the monasteries with the Mravaltskaro colourful mountains, with only about 1 km of easy walking in total. Summers here are very hot, so bring water, a hat and sunscreen.
- [Kakheti Day Trips from Tbilisi: Four Routes and Who Each Suits](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/kakheti-day-trips-from-tbilisi/): We run four Kakheti day routes: Sighnaghi and Bodbe; Ujarma to Alaverdi; Nekresi, Gremi and Telavi; and Gurjaani and Zegaani. Sighnaghi and Bodbe is best for a first visit, the Alaverdi route for monastery lovers, Gremi and Telavi for history fans, and Gurjaani and Zegaani for people who have already seen the classic sights.
- [Before You Travel: What Not to Forget Before Leaving Home](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/before-you-travel-checklist/): One or two weeks before departure, check your passport's validity and the entry rules, read your insurance policy, tell your bank you're travelling and sort out mobile data. In the last few days, make copies of your documents, download offline maps, check in for your flight and save emergency numbers, including the Consular Department hotline of Georgia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
- [Hand Luggage on Low-Cost Flights from Kutaisi: What Fits and What Doesn't](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/hand-luggage-low-cost-flights/): Most of our Kutaisi tours include one piece of hand luggage: 10 kg, 40x30x20 cm. That's the size of a small backpack, not a cabin trolley. Pack liquids in containers of up to 100 ml in one clear 1-litre bag, and keep your power bank in your hand luggage or on you.
- [Money Abroad: Card or Cash, Currency, ATMs and Extra Costs](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/money-abroad-cards-and-cash/): Take both: a card for hotels, shops and restaurants, and cash for small costs, markets and tips. Take euros for Europe and US dollars for our Egypt tours, where the visa and optional excursions are priced in dollars. Before you go, check your card's terms with your bank, and budget for optional excursions and museums in advance.
- [Jordan Visa for Georgian Citizens: On Arrival and Jordan Pass (2026)](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/jordan-visa-for-georgians/): Georgian citizens need a visa for Jordan, but usually do not have to get it in advance: Georgia is not on the Jordanian Ministry of Interior's list of 'restricted' nationalities, so you get the visa on arrival at Amman airport. A single-entry visa costs 40 Jordanian dinars, and Jordan Pass holders who stay at least two nights pay no visa fee (as of October 2026).
- [Morocco Visa for Georgian Citizens: eVisa or Embassy Visa (2026)](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/morocco-visa-for-georgians/): Yes, Georgian citizens need a visa for Morocco. According to Morocco's official portal (acces-maroc.ma), a Georgian can get an eVisa only if they hold a valid multiple-entry visa from the Schengen area, the USA, the UK or another listed country; otherwise the visa is issued through an embassy or consulate. The Morocco visa is included in the price of our Morocco tour.
- [India Visa for Georgian Citizens: e-Visa Types, Fees and Timing (2026)](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/india-e-visa-for-georgians/): Georgian citizens need a visa for India, but they can get it online: Georgia is on the list of countries eligible for India's official e-Visa. As of October 2026 the 30-day e-Tourist Visa costs 25 USD from July to March and 10 USD from April to June, and the 1-year one 40 USD. Apply at least 4 days before you arrive.
- [China Visa for Georgian Citizens: Visa-Free Rules and Hong Kong (2026)](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/china-visa-free-for-georgians/): No, Georgian citizens do not need a visa for a short trip to China. Since 28 May 2024 a mutual visa exemption agreement for ordinary passport holders has been in force: each stay must not exceed 30 days, and the total must not exceed 90 days in any 180-day period. Hong Kong has its own rules: Georgians can stay there visa-free for up to 30 days (as of October 2026).
- [Sri Lanka and Maldives Visa for Georgian Citizens (2026)](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/sri-lanka-eta-visa-for-georgians/): Georgian citizens need an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) for Sri Lanka, obtained on eta.gov.lk before arrival: a 30-day tourist ETA costs 50 USD in advance, 60 USD on arrival, and is free for children under 12 (as of October 2026). The Maldives grants a tourist visa on arrival free of charge, but you must submit an online Traveller Declaration within 96 hours before you arrive.
- [Kazbegi Day Trip from Tbilisi: Route, Drive and What to Wear](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/kazbegi-day-trip-from-tbilisi/): Our Kazbegi day tour leaves Tbilisi at 07:00 and is back at about 22:00. You see Dariali Monastery, the big and small Gveleti waterfalls, Gergeti Trinity Church and the Gudauri panorama. The longest walk is to the big waterfall: 1.2 km one way, medium difficulty.
- [Best Day Trips from Tbilisi: Where to Go and Who Each Suits](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/best-day-trips-from-tbilisi/): For little walking, pick Kakheti, the colourful desert or Kazbegi. If you like hiking, pick Truso (6-7 km one way, easy) or Lagodekhi (8.3 km one way, medium). Go to the mountain routes in the warm months. Kakheti and the lowland routes work for most of the year.
- [Cappadocia: Best Time to Visit and Hot-Air Balloon Flights](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/cappadocia-hot-air-balloons-best-time/): According to GoTürkiye, Türkiye's official tourism portal, the best time for a balloon ride is spring or autumn, when the weather is milder and more settled. Flights start just before sunrise, depend on the weather and can be cancelled. On our tour the flight is optional and costs 200-250 EUR.
- [Keukenhof 2027: When the Tulip Park in the Netherlands Is Open](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/keukenhof-tulip-season/): According to the official site keukenhof.nl, Keukenhof is open from Thursday 18 March to Sunday 9 May 2027, daily from 8:00 to 19:00, with last entry at 18:15. Flowering depends on the weather, so nobody can say in advance exactly which week will be best.
- [Group Tour Checklist: Documents and Packing for Travel from Georgia](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/group-tour-documents-packing-list/): Bring a passport valid for at least 6 months after the trip, travel insurance, cash and a card, an adapter, your medicines and hand luggage that fits low-cost rules (10 kg, 40x30x20 cm on our tours from Kutaisi). Under Georgian law, a child under 16 needs one parent's permission and an adult escort. If the child travels without a parent, bring a notarised consent and confirm the details in advance.
- [Egypt Visa for Georgian Citizens: e-Visa, Fee and Passport (2026)](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/egypt-visa-for-georgians/): Yes, Georgian citizens need a visa for Egypt. Georgia is on the list of countries whose citizens can get an e-Visa on Egypt's official portal: as of October 2026 a single-entry tourist e-Visa costs 30 USD and a multiple-entry one 65 USD. Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months from the day you arrive.
- [Turkey with a Georgian ID Card: Entry Rules for Georgian Citizens](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/turkey-entry-with-georgian-id-card/): Yes. According to Türkiye's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Georgia is on the list of countries whose citizens can enter Türkiye with their national ID card. Georgian citizens do not need a visa for trips of up to 90 days (as of October 2026). A child needs their own valid document.
- [Entering Armenia from Georgia: ID Card or Passport?](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/armenia-entry-from-georgia-id-or-passport/): Georgian citizens do not need a visa for Armenia. Under an agreement in force since 2023, you can enter Armenia with a biometric ID card through an international border checkpoint, or with your passport. Armenia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs says visa-free foreigners may stay no more than 180 days in a year, unless an international agreement sets a different term.
- [Schengen Without a Visa for Georgians: 90/180, Documents, ETIAS](https://besttraveler.ge/en/blog/schengen-visa-free-for-georgians/): Georgian citizens with an ordinary biometric passport do not need a visa for short stays in the Schengen area: up to 90 days in any 180-day period. Since March 2026 the visa exemption has been suspended only for diplomatic, service and official passports. As of October 2026 ETIAS is not yet in operation and no start date has been announced.
